wrappers.name: Bannerlator — Wrapper (default)
wrappers.description: Bannerlator's default graphics wrapper. Byte-identical to WinlatorMali's Wrapper (same file); also identical to Ludashi's Wrapper (Steven).
wrappers.author: Bruno/Winlator + Bannerlator

wrappers.name: Bannerlator — Wrapper (original)
wrappers.description: The original Winlator wrapper (Bruno's base). Byte-identical to WinNative's Wrapper and WinlatorMali's Wrapper v2 (verified same file).
wrappers.author: Bruno (brunodev85) — Winlator

wrappers.name: Bannerlator — Wrapper (legacy)
wrappers.description: Bannerlator's legacy wrapper build. Unique to Bannerlator.
wrappers.author: Bannerlator

wrappers.name: Bannerlator — leegao
wrappers.description: Bannerlator's leegao ICD build. Each project ships its own leegao build (this one differs from WinlatorMali's and WinNative's).
wrappers.author: leegao + Bannerlator

wrappers.name: Bannerlator — GameNative
wrappers.description: The GameNative wrapper (DX12 + integrated BCn). Byte-identical to WinlatorMali's GameNative (same file); WinNative ships a different build.
wrappers.author: GameNative

wrappers.name: Bannerlator — BCn layer (leegao)
wrappers.description: leegao BCn texture-transcode layer (upstream shader-v3). Import into the BCn layer slot. For non-Adreno GPUs.
wrappers.author: leegao

wrappers.name: Bannerlator — Wrapper + compat + bcn (Mali DX12)
wrappers.description: Full Mali DX12 stack: leegao ICD + BCn layer + DXVK-Mali compat layer. Valhall Mali r32p1+.
wrappers.author: leegao + Bannerlator

wrappers.name: WinlatorMali — Wrapper
wrappers.description: WinlatorMali's default wrapper. Byte-identical to Bannerlator's Wrapper (default) (same file); also identical to Ludashi's Wrapper (Steven).

wrappers.name: WinlatorMali — Wrapper v2
wrappers.description: WinlatorMali's 'v2' wrapper — byte-identical to the Bruno original (Bannerlator Wrapper original / WinNative Wrapper).
wrappers.author: GunaCharanTeja (WinlatorMali)

wrappers.name: WinlatorMali — leegao
wrappers.description: WinlatorMali's leegao ICD build (differs from Bannerlator's and WinNative's leegao).
wrappers.author: leegao + GunaCharanTeja

wrappers.name: WinlatorMali — GameNative
wrappers.description: WinlatorMali's GameNative wrapper. Byte-identical to Bannerlator's GameNative (same file).
